description: Search mid/long-term rental listings on HousingAnywhere by city, or fetch full details for specific listing URLs.

availableNow.description: Keep only listings whose move-in date is today or already open.
availableNow.title: Available now only

bedroomCounts.description: Filter apartments by number of bedrooms.
bedroomCounts.title: Bedroom count (apartments)

billsIncluded.description: Filter by whether utility bills are included in the rent.
billsIncluded.title: Utilities / bills

cancellationPolicy.description: Filter by the booking cancellation policy.
cancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation policy

contractType.description: Filter by how rent is calculated (daily, fortnightly or monthly).
contractType.title: Contract type

depositPolicy.description: Filter by the deposit policy advertised on the listing.
depositPolicy.title: Deposit policy

gender.description: Filter listings restricted to a specific gender.
gender.title: Gender preference

includeDetails.description: For each search result, also fetch its detail page (description, facilities, tenant preferences, images). Slower — one extra request per listing.
includeDetails.title: Include full listing details

location.description: City to search, e.g. `Berlin`, `Berlin, Germany`, `Amsterdam`, `New York`. Resolved automatically to the matching HousingAnywhere city.
location.title: City / location (mode=search)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (1–10000). The source's own city total is the real ceiling.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Maximum monthly rent, in the searched city's local currency.
maxPrice.title: Max price (per month, local currency)

minPrice.description: Minimum monthly rent, in the searched city's local currency (e.g. EUR for Berlin, USD for New York).
minPrice.title: Min price (per month, local currency)

minRating.description: Drop listings whose advertiser rating is below this value (0-5). Listings without a rating yet are kept.
minRating.title: Min advertiser rating

enumTitles: Fetch full details for listing URLs
mode.title: Mode

propertyTypes.description: Filter to specific property types. Leave empty for all types.
propertyTypes.title: Property types

recentlyAdded.description: Only show listings added within this time window.
recentlyAdded.title: Recently added

registrationPossible.description: Filter by whether municipal address registration is possible at this address.
registrationPossible.title: Address registration

searchUrls.description: HousingAnywhere search page URLs, e.g. `https://housinganywhere.com/s/Berlin--Germany/private-rooms?priceMax=80000`. Use this to run several cities or to reuse filters configured on the site. Explicit filters below are also applied.
searchUrls.title: Search URLs (advanced)
